summary: Tested HR Remarks, Optional Reviews, Previous Payslips, and PDF Review Exclusion features. All 9 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified - Create Payslip modal with HR Remarks field, Optional Operations/CEO reviews with Skip option, Previous Payslips section, and Download PDF button all working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created test payslips for months July-December 2026 and January/June 2027 to verify HR Remarks, Optional Reviews, and PDF generation features
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new payroll features verified: 1) Create Payslip modal includes HR Remarks (Optional) field with textarea and helper text, 2) Operations Review is optional - can submit empty to skip and forward to CEO, 3) CEO Review is optional - can approve without comment, 4) Previous Payslips section shows employee's historical payslips sorted by date descending, 5) HR Remarks displayed in payslip details and included in PDF, 6) Reviews stored in DB but excluded from PDF per code comment at line 1075

create_payslip_with_hr_remarks.details: Create Payslip modal shows HR Remarks (Optional) field with textarea, placeholder text, and helper text 'These remarks will appear on the payslip'

hr_remarks_saved_and_displayed.details: HR Remarks saved to database and displayed in payslip details UI (visible in Net Salary section)

previous_payslips_section.details: Previous Payslips section shows for employee with collapsible list, badge showing record count (e.g., '9 records'), sorted by date descending

operations_review_optional.details: Operations Review modal shows 'Your Review (Optional)' label, placeholder 'Enter your review or leave empty to skip...', helper text 'You can skip the review and just forward to CEO', button changes to 'Skip & Forward to CEO' when empty

ceo_review_optional.details: CEO Review is optional - can approve payslip without entering review text. Backend accepts empty review_text and moves status to approved

pdf_excludes_reviews.details: PDF generation endpoint works correctly. Code comment at line 1075 confirms reviews are NOT included in PDF. HR Remarks IS included in PDF if provided

employee_payslips_endpoint.details: GET /api/payroll/employee-payslips/{user_id} returns list of payslips sorted by year/month descending

api_tests.POST /api/payroll/payslip/create with hr: PASS - Creates payslip with HR Remarks field saved
api_tests.POST /api/payroll/payslip/create without: PASS - HR Remarks is optional, defaults to empty string
api_tests.PUT /api/payroll/payslip/{id}/operations: PASS - Accepts empty review_text, moves to ceo_review status
api_tests.PUT /api/payroll/payslip/{id}/ceo-review: PASS - Accepts empty review_text, moves to approved status
api_tests.GET /api/payroll/employee-payslips/{user: PASS - Returns previous payslips sorted by date descending
api_tests.GET /api/payroll/payslip/{id}/pdf: PASS - Returns valid PDF with HR Remarks included, reviews excluded
